videos.title: All of the Holidays at Once
videos.name: All of the Holidays at Once
videos.overview: The makers race to create last-minute Halloween costumes using common household items before turning their attention to celebrating all of the holidays at once with front door displays for Valentine's Day, Easter, the Fourth of July and more.

videos.title: All the Holidays at Once
videos.name: All the Holidays at Once
videos.overview: Nick and Amy celebrate the holidays with the Makers; everyone creates a handmade Halloween costume that incorporates an optical illusion; for the Master Craft, Makers decorate an ordinary fireplace mantel using their favorite holiday as inspiration.
